description_en: Queries the performance metrics of an instance
description_zh: 该接口用于查询实例性能数据
kebab_example: aliyun rds describe-db-instance-performance --db-instance-id rm-uf6wjk50000 --key MySQL_NetworkTraffic --start-time 2012-06-08T15:00Z --end-time 2012-06-18T15:00Z --node-id 3390000 --region cn-hangzhou
name: DescribeDBInstancePerformance

parameters.help_en: The instance ID. You can call the DescribeDBInstances operation to query the instance ID
parameters.name: db_instance_id

parameters.help_en:
The performance metrics that you want to query. Separate multiple values with commas (,). You can specify up to 30 values. For more information, see https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/26316.html.

If you set Key to MySQL_SpaceUsage or SQLServer_SpaceUsage, you can query the monitoring data within only one day
parameters.help_zh:
想要查询的性能指标，多个值用半角逗号（,）分隔，最多传入30个。详细参数请参见https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/26316.html。
Key为MySQL_SpaceUsage或SQLServer_SpaceUsage时，仅支持查询1天内的监控数据
parameters.name: key

parameters.help_en:
The beginning of the time range to query. Specify the time in the ISO 8601 standard in the yyyy-MM-ddTHH:mmZ format. The time must be in UTC.

The time span between the beginning time and the end time must be longer than the monitoring frequency. Otherwise, this operation may return an empty array
parameters.help_zh: 查询开始时间。格式：yyyy-MM-ddTHH:mmZ（UTC时间）。 开始和结束时间间隔需要大于您实例的监控频率，否则可能返回空列表
parameters.name: start_time

parameters.help_en:
The end of the time range to query. Specify the time in the ISO 8601 standard in the yyyy-MM-ddTHH:mmZ format. The time must be in UTC.

The time span between the beginning time and the end time must be longer than the monitoring frequency. Otherwise, this operation may return an empty array
parameters.help_zh: 查询结束时间。格式：yyyy-MM-ddTHH:mmZ（UTC时间）。 开始和结束时间间隔需要大于您实例的监控频率，否则可能返回空列表
parameters.name: end_time
